title: ListViewModel Init Task Lifecycle
requirements: Move the initial refresh Task out of ListViewModel.init (currently a discarded `Task { await refresh() }`) into ContentView.body via `.task { await vm.refresh() }` so SwiftUI auto-cancels it on disappear
Alternatively, store the Task handle in a private var `initTask` on ListViewModel and cancel it in a `teardown()` — but prefer the `.task` modifier on the view as the canonical approach
No unstructured fire-and-forget Task in init that can touch @Observable state after the view-model is deallocated
Preserve the initial-refresh behavior: the timeline is populated when ContentView first appears
acceptance_criteria: No leaked Task after window/frame destruction; @MainActor state is touched only from a visible view-model
The timeline still populates on first appearance
No task handle is discarded without storage or .task/lifecycle binding
